entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One single independent inventory equipment icon for a 2D hand-drawn fairy-tale mobile RPG. This is BASIC EARLY-GAME EQUIPMENT, modest ordinary practical gear, not a legendary item. Very simple illustrated cartoon game sprite: thick confident dark outline, slightly organic hand-drawn contour, flat local colors with only TWO broad cel-shaded tones and one restrained highlight. Large clean shapes; very few internal lines. Matte surfaces. Strong legibility at 64px. Warm muted natural colors. No realistic material rendering, no painterly microtexture, no scratches, no detailed folds, no tiny stitching, no engraving, no filigree. No red ribbons, wax seals, thorn motifs, crescent motifs, heraldry, gems, excessive spikes, magical glow or Little Red Riding Hood themed embellishments. Do not make a branded matching costume set. One object on a genuinely transparent square background, centered and fully visible, occupies about 75% canvas with clear margin. No text, labels, panels, card frames, characters, body parts, scenery or drop shadows. Subject: A short practical iron arming sword tilted diagonally from lower left to upper right. Broad simple pale grey blade with a clipped tip, straight dark iron crossguard, plain brown wooden handle. Just blade, crossguard and handle. Simple chunky recognizable silhouette.
